semantics: decrement before initial affine; then each guarded total-loop summary INCLUDING its zero exit affine

loop_contracts.triangular: If R6=0, preserve all registers before zero_exit. If R6>0, simultaneously set R1=R6=0, add (old R1+old R6)*(old R1+old R6+1)/2 to R7, preserve all other registers; then apply zero_exit matrix.
loop_contracts.clear: If R6=0, preserve all registers before zero_exit. If R6>0, set R5=R6=0 and preserve all other registers; then apply zero_exit matrix.
